#Packages
```{r}
data_management_packages_to_install <- c("data.table", "tidyverse", "readxl", "yarrr", "ggplot2", "zoo", "ggdist", "ggbeeswarm", "GGally", "cowplot", "magick", "pdftools", "scales", "viridis", "sysfonts","showtext","knitr","gtable", "ijtiff","ggtext")

packages_to_install <- c(data_management_packages_to_install)

# Check and install packages using a for loop
for (package in packages_to_install) {
  if (!requireNamespace(package, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package)
  }
  library(package, character.only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
        ) %>%

data_excessDeaths
```

```{r}
library(zoo)
rollingmin_excessdeaths_data <- alldata_excessDeaths %>%
  rename(pub_piv_burials_cremats_2020_2021 = "2020_2021_pub_priv_burials_cremats") %>%
  select(Covid_dates_2020_2021, 
         pub_piv_burials_cremats_2020_2021,
         PreCovid_deaths_adjusted
         ) %>%
  mutate(Covid_dates_2020_2021 = as.Date(Covid_dates_2020_2021),
         PreCovid_deaths_15d_center_running_mean = rollapply(PreCovid_deaths_adjusted, 
                                                            width = 15, 
                                                            FUN = mean,
                                                            align = "center", 
                                                            fill = NA),
         Covid_period_excess_deaths_mean = pub_piv_burials_cremats_2020_2021 - PreCovid_deaths_15d_center_running_mean,
         PreCovid_deaths_7d_center_running_min = rollapply(PreCovid_deaths_adjusted, 
                                                            width = 7, 
                                                            FUN = min,
                                                            align = "center", 
                                                            fill = NA),
         Covid_period_excess_deaths_min = pub_piv_burials_cremats_2020_2021 - PreCovid_deaths_7d_center_running_min,
         FUN_diff = Covid_period_excess_deaths_min - Covid_period_excess_deaths_mean
         ) 

rollingmin_excessdeaths_data
```

```{r figure1-a, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN/2, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/6}
Figure_1a <- rollingmin_excessdeaths_data %>%

  geom_col(
    aes(y = Covid_period_excess_deaths_mean),
    width = 1,
    fill = "lightgray"

  geom_col(
    data = data_hospdeaths %>%
      rename(date = DT_EVOLUTION) %>%
      mutate(
        AGEGROUP = case_when(
          AGEGROUP == "[70,inf]" ~ "70+",
          TRUE ~ sub("\\]", ")", AGEGROUP)
        )
      ),
    aes(y = count, fill = AGEGROUP),
    width = 1
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = color_to_age_map,
    name = "Age group"
  ) +

  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    limits = as.Date(c("2020-02-15", "2021-05-15")),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = function(x) {
      m <- format(x, "%m")
      y <- format(x, "%y")

      ifelse(
        x == as.Date("2020-03-01"),
        "Mar\n20",
        ifelse(
          m == "01",
          paste0("Jan\n", y),
          ifelse(
            m %in% c("03", "05", "07", "09", "11"),
            format(x, "%b"),
            ""
          )
        )
      )
    }
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 200),
    breaks = seq(0, 200, 50),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Daily deaths"
  ) +

  theme_pub +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(1, 1),
    legend.justification = c("right", "top")
  )
```

### b
```{r figure1-b, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN/2, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/6}
Figure_1b <- strain_frequency_amazonas %>%
  mutate(
    date = date + 15,
    lineage = case_when(
      `Linhagens relevantes` == "B.1.1.28" ~ "B.1.1.28",
      `Linhagens relevantes` == "B.1.1.33" ~ "B.1.1.33",
      `Linhagens relevantes` == "P.1+P.1.* (Gama)" ~ "P.1",
      `Linhagens relevantes` == "P.2" ~ "P.2",
      TRUE ~ "B.1.195 & Others"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(date, lineage, rel_freq) %>%
  add_row(
    date = as.Date("2020-02-01"),
    lineage = "B.1.195 & Others",
    rel_freq = 1
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lineage = factor(
      lineage,
      levels = c(
        "B.1.195 & Others",
        "B.1.1.33",
        "B.1.1.28",
        "P.2",
        "P.1"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(date, lineage) %>%
  summarise(
    rel_freq = sum(rel_freq),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    date, lineage,
    fill = list(rel_freq = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(lineage) %>%
  mutate(
    first_nonzero = min(date[rel_freq > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    smoothing_start = max(
      date[date < first_nonzero],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    smoothing_start = case_when(
      smoothing_start == -Inf ~ min(date),
      TRUE ~ smoothing_start
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(lineage) %>%
  complete(
    date = seq(min(date), max(date), by = "day")
  ) %>%
  fill(
    first_nonzero, smoothing_start,
    .direction = "downup"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_freq = ifelse(date < smoothing_start, 0, rel_freq),
    rel_freq = pmax(
      zoo::na.approx(rel_freq, x = date),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  fill(rel_freq, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  ggplot(
    aes(x = date, fill = lineage, colour = lineage)
  ) +

  geom_area(
    aes(y = rel_freq),
    position = "fill",
    alpha = 0.8,
    linewidth = 0,
    linetype = 0
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = strain_frequency %>%
      mutate(
        fraction = positive / number,
        lineage = "P.1"
      ),
    aes(y = fraction),
    size = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    data = strain_frequency %>%
      mutate(
        fraction = positive / number,
        lineage = "P.1"
      ),
    aes(
      ymin = mapply(
        function(x, n) binom.test(x, n)$conf.int[1],
        positive, number
      ),
      ymax = mapply(
        function(x, n) binom.test(x, n)$conf.int[2],
        positive, number
      )
    ),
    width = 5,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    limits = as.Date(c("2020-02-15", "2021-05-15")),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = function(x) {
      m <- format(x, "%m")
      y <- format(x, "%y")

      ifelse(
        x == as.Date("2020-03-01"),
        "Mar\n20",
        ifelse(
          m == "01",
          paste0("Jan\n", y),
          ifelse(
            m %in% c("03", "05", "07", "09", "11"),
            format(x, "%b"),
            ""
          )
        )
      )
    }
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Lineage",
    values = c(
      "B.1.195 & Others" = "#56B4E9",
      "B.1.1.28" = "#F0E442",
      "B.1.1.33" = "#009E73",
      "P.2" = "#E69F00",
      "P.1" = "#D55E00"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "B.1.1.28",
      "B.1.1.33",
      "B.1.195 & Others",
      "P.1",
      "P.2"
    )
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Lineage",
    values = c(
      "B.1.195 & Others" = "#56B4E9",
      "B.1.1.28" = "#F0E442",
      "B.1.1.33" = "#009E73",
      "P.2" = "#E69F00",
      "P.1" = "black"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "B.1.1.28",
      "B.1.1.33",
      "B.1.195 & Others",
      "P.1",
      "P.2"
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    labels = function(x) x * 100,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative frequency (%)"
  ) +

  theme_pub +

  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      title.position = "left"
    )
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

Figure_1b
```

```{r figure1-d, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN/2, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/4}
Figure_1d <- data_EightCities_agebin %>%
  mutate(
    result_color = case_when(
      result >= 1.40 ~ "Pos",

      result <= 0.1 ~ "Neg"
    ),
    result_color = factor(
      result_color,
      levels = c("Pos", "Pos_ind", "Neg_ind", "Neg")
```

#Figure 2
## top
### a
```{r, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/2}
Figure_2a <- list()

agegroups_2a <- unique(
  as.character(
    manaus_2w_simp_hospdeaths_predictions_with_data$AGEGROUP
  )
)

for (agegroup in agegroups_2a) {

  df_age <- manaus_2w_simp_hospdeaths_predictions_with_data %>%
    filter(AGEGROUP == agegroup)

  Figure_2a_subplot <- ggplot(df_age, aes(x = date)) +

    # Simulated hospital deaths
    geom_ribbon(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "simulated_hospdeaths"),
      aes(
        ymin = q05,
        ymax = q95,
        fill = AGEGROUP
      ),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +

    # Observed hospital deaths
    geom_point(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "data_hospdeaths"),
      aes(
        y = q50,
        colour = AGEGROUP
      ),
      size = 0.4
    ) +
    
    # Expected hospital deaths
    geom_ribbon(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "expected_hospdeaths"),
      aes(
        ymin = q05,
        ymax = q95,
        fill = AGEGROUP,
        colour = AGEGROUP
      ),
      alpha = 0.3,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_line(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "expected_hospdeaths"),
      aes(y = q50),
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(values = color_to_age_map) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_to_age_map) +

    scale_x_date(
      date_breaks = "1 month",
      limits = as.Date(c("2020-03-01", "2021-05-01")),
      expand = c(0, 0),
      labels = function(x) {
        m <- format(x, "%m")
        y <- format(x, "%y")

        ifelse(
          x == as.Date("2020-03-01"),
          "Mar\n20",
          ifelse(
            m == "01",
            paste0("Jan\n", y),
            ifelse(
              m %in% c("03", "05", "07", "09", "11"),
              format(x, "%b"),
              ""
            )
          )
        )
      }
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Hospital deaths"
    ) +

    # One age-group label per subplot
    geom_text(
      aes(label = AGEGROUP, x = (min(date) + (max(date) - min(date))/2)), 
      y = Inf, 
      vjust = 1.5, 
      family = BASE_FAM,
      size = font_pt("small") / ggplot2::.pt,
      check_overlap = TRUE) + 

    theme_pub +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 0,
        unit = "pt"
      )
    )

  Figure_2a[[agegroup]] <- Figure_2a_subplot
}

# Retain the original ordering
Figure_2a <- unname(Figure_2a[agegroups_2a])

stopifnot(length(Figure_2a) == 8L)

# Only the middle-left subplot needs the y-axis title
for (i in setdiff(seq_along(Figure_2a), 4)) {
  Figure_2a[[i]] <- Figure_2a[[i]] +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
}

for(i in c(1,2,3,5,6,7,8) ) {
  Figure_2a[[i]] <- Figure_2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
}

for(i in 6:8 ) {
  Figure_2a[[i]] <- Figure_2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0, r=8, 0, 0, "pt"),
    )
}

for(i in 1:3 ) {
  Figure_2a[[i]] <- Figure_2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t=4, 0, 0, 0, "pt"),
    )
}



for(i in 1:5) {
  Figure_2a[[i]] <- Figure_2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
```

```{r, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN/3, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/5}
Figure_2c <- manaus_2w_simp_phylo_predictions_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +

  # Simulated phylogenetic data
  geom_ribbon(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "simulated_phylodata"),
    aes(
      ymin = q05 / number,
      ymax = q95 / number
    ),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  
  # Observed lineage frequencies
  geom_point(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "data_phylo"),
    aes(
      y = q50 / number,
      size = number
    )
  ) +

  # Expected phylogenetic data
  geom_ribbon(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "expected_phylodata"),
    aes(
      ymin = q05 / number,
      ymax = q95 / number
    ),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "expected_phylodata"),
    aes(y = q50 / number),
    linewidth = 0.4,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    limits = as.Date(c("2020-05-01", "2021-01-10")),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = function(x) {
      m <- format(x, "%m")
      y <- format(x, "%y")

      ifelse(
        x == as.Date("2020-05-01"),
        "May\n20",
        ifelse(
          m == "01",
          paste0("Jan\n", y),
          ifelse(
            m %in% c("03", "05", "07", "09", "11"),
            format(x, "%b"),
            ""
          )
        )
      )
    }
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    labels = function(x) x * 100,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 50),
    breaks = c(1, 10, 25, 50),
    range = c(0.2, 1.5)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "P.1 (%)",
    size = "Sample size"
  ) +

  theme_pub +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 8, r = 0, b = 0, l = 4,
      unit = "pt"
    )
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/2}
      ifelse(
        x == as.Date("2020-03-01"),
        "Mar\n20",

          m == "01",
          paste0("Jan\n", y),
          ifelse(
            m %in% c("03", "05", "07", "09", "11"),
            format(x, "%b"),
            ""
          )
        )
      )
    }

  scale_y_continuous(
```

```{r}
# Convert Figure 3A to a grob
g3a <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(Figure_3a)

# Locate the left y-axis
axis_idx <- grep("^axis-l", g3a$layout$name)[1]

# Extract the axis label text grob
axis_text <- g3a$grobs[[axis_idx]]$
  children$axis$grobs[[2]]$children[[1]]

# Check that we have the correct labels
axis_text$label

# Keep the default centre alignment for all labels
axis_text$vjust <- rep(0.5, length(axis_text$label))

# Bottom-align only the "20" label
axis_text$vjust[axis_text$label == "10"] <- 0.6
axis_text$vjust[axis_text$label == "20"] <- 0.1

# Insert the modified text grob
g3a$grobs[[axis_idx]]$
  children$axis$grobs[[2]]$children[[1]] <- axis_text
```

#Figure S3
```{r, fig.width = FIG_WIDTH_IN, fig.height = FIG_WIDTH_IN}
totals <- manaus_2w_simp_sims %>%
  filter(state == "total_N") %>%
  select(
    date,
    AGEGROUP,
    q50_total = q50,
    q05_total = q05,
    q95_total = q95
  )

Figure_S3_data <- manaus_2w_simp_sims %>%
  filter(state != "total_N") %>%
  left_join(
    totals,
    by = c("date", "AGEGROUP")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q50_prop = q50 / q50_total,
    q05_prop = q05 / q05_total,
    q95_prop = q95 / q95_total,
    AGEGROUP = factor(AGEGROUP)
  )

# Population-level proportions for the dashed curves
Figure_S3_aggregated <- Figure_S3_data %>%
  group_by(date, state) %>%
  summarise(
    aggregated_q50_prop = sum(q50, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(q50_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# One state label per facet
Figure_S3_labels <- Figure_S3_data %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    date = min(date) + (max(date) - min(date)) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Figure_S3 <- ggplot(
  Figure_S3_data,
  aes(x = date)
) +

  # Uncertainty ribbons
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = q05_prop,
      ymax = q95_prop,
      fill = AGEGROUP,
      group = AGEGROUP
    ),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +

  # Age-group trajectories
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = q50_prop,
      colour = AGEGROUP,
      group = AGEGROUP
    ),
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # Population-level trajectories
  geom_line(
    data = Figure_S3_aggregated,
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = aggregated_q50_prop
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = color_to_age_map,
    name = "Age group"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = color_to_age_map,
    name = "Age group"
  ) +

  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 months",
    date_minor_breaks = "1 month",
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(as.Date("2020-03-01"), NA),
    labels = scales::label_date_short(
      format = c("%y", "%b")
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
    labels = scales::label_number()
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~state,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3,
    nrow = 4,
    dir = "v"
  ) +

  # State labels inside facets
  geom_text(
    data = Figure_S3_labels,
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = Inf,
      label = state
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    vjust = 1.5,
    family = BASE_FAM,
    size = font_pt("small") / ggplot2::.pt
  ) +

  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      title = "Age group",
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.6)
    ),
    fill = "none"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Fraction of age group"
  ) +

  theme_pub +

  theme(
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(4, "pt"),

    strip.placement = "inside",
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.4),
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.background = element_blank()
  )
```

# Figure S2
## top
### a
```{r, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/2}
Figure_S2a <- list()

agegroups_S2a <- unique(
  as.character(
    manaus_2w_SIRS_hospdeaths_predictions_with_data$AGEGROUP
  )
)

for (agegroup in agegroups_S2a) {

  df_age <- manaus_2w_SIRS_hospdeaths_predictions_with_data %>%
    filter(AGEGROUP == agegroup)

  Figure_S2a_subplot <- ggplot(df_age, aes(x = date)) +

    # Simulated hospital deaths
    geom_ribbon(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "simulated_hospdeaths"),
      aes(
        ymin = q05,
        ymax = q95,
        fill = AGEGROUP
      ),
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +

    # Observed hospital deaths
    geom_point(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "data_hospdeaths"),
      aes(
        y = q50,
        colour = AGEGROUP
      ),
      size = 0.4
    ) +

    # Expected hospital deaths
    geom_ribbon(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "expected_hospdeaths"),
      aes(
        ymin = q05,
        ymax = q95,
        fill = AGEGROUP,
        colour = AGEGROUP
      ),
      alpha = 0.3,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +

    geom_line(
      data = df_age %>%
        filter(state == "expected_hospdeaths"),
      aes(y = q50),
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(values = color_to_age_map) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_to_age_map) +

    scale_x_date(
      date_breaks = "1 month",
      limits = as.Date(c("2020-03-01", "2021-05-01")),
      expand = c(0, 0),
      labels = function(x) {
        m <- format(x, "%m")
        y <- format(x, "%y")

        ifelse(
          x == as.Date("2020-03-01"),
          "Mar\n20",
          ifelse(
            m == "01",
            paste0("Jan\n", y),
            ifelse(
              m %in% c("03", "05", "07", "09", "11"),
              format(x, "%b"),
              ""
            )
          )
        )
      }
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Hospital deaths"
    ) +

    # One age-group label per subplot
    geom_text(
      aes(label = AGEGROUP, x = (min(date) + (max(date) - min(date))/2)),
      y = Inf,
      vjust = 1.5,
      family = BASE_FAM,
      size = font_pt("small") / ggplot2::.pt,
      check_overlap = TRUE) +

    theme_pub +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 0, r = 1, b = 0, l = 0,
        unit = "pt"
      )
    )

  Figure_S2a[[agegroup]] <- Figure_S2a_subplot
}

# Retain the original ordering
Figure_S2a <- unname(Figure_S2a[agegroups_S2a])

stopifnot(length(Figure_S2a) == 8L)

# Only the middle-left subplot needs the y-axis title
for (i in setdiff(seq_along(Figure_S2a), 4)) {
  Figure_S2a[[i]] <- Figure_S2a[[i]] +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
}

for(i in c(1,2,3,5,6,7,8) ) {
  Figure_S2a[[i]] <- Figure_S2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
}

for(i in 6:8 ) {
  Figure_S2a[[i]] <- Figure_S2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0, r=8, 0, 0, "pt"),
    )
}

for(i in 1:3 ) {
  Figure_S2a[[i]] <- Figure_S2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(t=4, 0, 0, 0, "pt"),
    )
}

for(i in 1:5) {
  Figure_S2a[[i]] <- Figure_S2a[[i]] +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length.x = unit(0, "pt")
    )
}
```

```{r, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN/3, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/5}
  scale_size_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 50),
    breaks = c(1, 10, 25, 50),
    range = c(0.2, 1.5)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "P.1 (%)",
    size = "Sample size"
  ) +

  theme_pub +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 8, r = 0, b = 0, l = 4,
      unit = "pt"
    )
  )

Figure_S2c
```

## bottom
### b
```{r, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN/2}
Figure_S2b <- manaus_2w_SIRS_sero_predictions_data %>%
  mutate(
    AGEGROUP = case_when(
      AGEGROUP == "[70,inf]" ~ "70+",
      AGEGROUP == "[70+]" ~ "70+",
      TRUE ~ sub("\\]", ")", AGEGROUP)
    )
  ) %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = median_date)) +

  # Simulated seroprevalence
  geom_ribbon(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "simulated_serodata"),
    aes(
      ymin = q05 / SampleSize,
      ymax = q95 / SampleSize,
      fill = AGEGROUP
    ),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +

  # Observed seroprevalence
  geom_point(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "data_sero"),
    aes(
      y = q50 / SampleSize,
      colour = AGEGROUP,
      size = SampleSize
    )
  ) +

  # Expected seroprevalence
  geom_ribbon(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "expected_serodata"),
    aes(
      ymin = q05 / SampleSize,
      ymax = q95 / SampleSize,
      fill = AGEGROUP,
      colour = AGEGROUP
    ),
    alpha = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = . %>%
      filter(state == "expected_serodata"),
    aes(y = q50 / SampleSize),
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_text(
      aes(label = AGEGROUP, x = (min(median_date) + (max(median_date) - min(median_date))/2)),
      y = Inf,
      vjust = 1.5,
      family = BASE_FAM,
      size = font_pt("small") / ggplot2::.pt,
      check_overlap = TRUE
    ) +

  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    limits = c(as.Date("2020-03-01"), NA),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = function(x) {
      m <- format(x, "%m")
      y <- format(x, "%y")

      ifelse(
        x == as.Date("2020-03-01"),
        "Mar\n20",
        ifelse(
          m == "01",
          paste0("Jan\n", y),
          ifelse(
            m %in% c("03", "05", "07", "09", "11"),
            format(x, "%b"),
            ""
          )
        )
      )
    }
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03)),
    labels = function(x) x * 100
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = color_to_age_map
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = color_to_age_map
  ) +

  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(0.2, 1.5),
    name = "Sample size"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~AGEGROUP,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +

  guides(
    size = guide_legend(
      title = "Sample size",
      override.aes = list(colour = "black")
    ),
    colour = "none",
    fill = "none"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Seroprevalence (%)"
  ) +

  theme_pub +

  theme(
    # Compact facet layout
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(6, "pt"),

    # Age-group labels
    strip.placement = "inside",
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "right",

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 8, r = 0, b = 0, l = 8,
      unit = "pt"
    )
  )

Figure_S2b
```

```{r}
library("invgamma")
```


```{r, fig.width=FIG_WIDTH_IN, fig.height=FIG_WIDTH_IN*20/28}
Figure_S4 <- plot_grid(
  manaus_2w_updated_draws_df %>% 
    select(gamma, .chain) %>%
    mutate(.chain = as.factor(.chain)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = gamma)) +
    geom_density(
      aes(fill = .chain, color = .chain),
      alpha = 0.7,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_function(
      aes(color = "Prior"),
      fun = invgamma::dinvgamma,
      args = list(shape = 22.6, rate = 2.44),
      linewidth = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Prior" = "red")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.05, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = "recovery rate",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = invgamma::qinvgamma(
        p = 0.025, shape = 22.6, rate = 2.44
      ),
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = invgamma::qinvgamma(
        p = 0.975, shape = 22.6, rate = 2.44
      ),
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = font_pt("body")
      ),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 2, 0, 4, "pt")
    ),

  manaus_2w_updated_draws_df %>% 
    select(w, .chain) %>%
    mutate(.chain = as.factor(.chain)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = w)) +
    geom_density(
      aes(fill = .chain, color = .chain),
      alpha = 0.7,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_function(
      aes(color = "Prior"),
      fun = function(x) invgamma::dinvgamma(
        x, shape = 2.4, rate = 0.0153
      ),
      linewidth = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = invgamma::qinvgamma(
        p = 0.025, shape = 2.4, rate = 0.0153
      ),
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = invgamma::qinvgamma(
        p = 0.975, shape = 2.4, rate = 0.0153
      ),
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Prior" = "red")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.05), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = "waning rate") +
    theme_pub +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = font_pt("body")
      ),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 2, 0, 4, "pt")
    ),

  manaus_2w_updated_draws_df %>% 
    select(log10_ifr1_slope, .chain) %>%
    mutate(.chain = as.factor(.chain)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = log10_ifr1_slope)) +
    geom_density(
      aes(fill = .chain, color = .chain),
      alpha = 0.7,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_function(
      aes(color = "Prior"),
      fun = dnorm,
      args = list(mean = 0.524, sd = 0.013),
      linewidth = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = qnorm(
        p = 0.025, mean = 0.524, sd = 0.013
      ),
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = qnorm(
        p = 0.975, mean = 0.524, sd = 0.013
      ),
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("Prior" = "red")) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0.45, 0.6),
      breaks = seq(0.45, 0.6, by = 0.05),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = "log10(IFR1 slope)",

  align = "hv"
)
```
